p=mk()

# exactly 500 ok

# approved
p=mk(); refund(p, Decimal("600.00"), T0, approved_by="boss"); print("approved", p.refunded_amount)

p=mk(); r1=refund(p, Decimal("100.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1"); r2=refund(p, Decimal("100.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")

# over refund
p=mk("100.00"); refund(p, Decimal("60.00"), T0)
try: refund(p, Decimal("50.00"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("over:", e.code)
EOF"}
